title: Frank Grillo: Only 1% Know These 3 Facts
script:
Only 1% of fans know these 3 Frank Grillo facts. Can you? Get ready to test your knowledge on the action star! Three seconds per question. Let's go!

Question one: In which Marvel movie did Frank Grillo first appear as Brock Rumlow? Was it Captain America: The Winter Soldier, Civil War, or Endgame?
(Pause)
It was Captain America: The Winter Soldier! He debuted there.

Question two: Which martial art is Frank Grillo a highly skilled practitioner of? Is it Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Boxing, or Muay Thai?
(Pause)
It's Boxing! He's been boxing since he was 18.

Final challenge: What was the name of Frank Grillo's character in the first Purge movie? Leo Barnes, Sergeant, or James Sandin?
(Pause)
The correct answer is James Sandin! He led the original film.

How many did you get right? Did you ace all three? Only 1% of fans know these 3 Frank Grillo facts. Can you?
